description: Creates a merge request if it does not exist.

parameters.name: api_job_token
parameters.description: GitLab CI job token for logging in.

parameters.name: api_oauth_token
parameters.description: GitLab OAuth token for logging in.

parameters.name: api_password
parameters.description: The password to use for authentication against the API.

parameters.name: api_token
parameters.description: GitLab access token with API permissions.

parameters.name: api_url
parameters.description: The resolvable endpoint for the API.

parameters.name: api_username
parameters.description: The username to use for authentication against the API.

parameters.name: assignee_ids
parameters.description: Comma separated list of assignees usernames omitting @ character. Set to empty string to unassign all assignees.

parameters.name: ca_path
parameters.description: The CA certificates bundle to use to verify GitLab server certificate.

parameters.name: description
parameters.description: A description for the merge request. Gets overridden by a content of file specified at description_path, if found.

parameters.name: description_path
parameters.description: A path of file containing merge request’s description. Accepts MarkDown formatted files.

parameters.name: labels
parameters.description: Comma separated list of label names. Default: ""

parameters.name: project
parameters.description: The path or name of the project.

parameters.name: remove_source_branch
parameters.description: Flag indicating if a merge request should remove the source branch when merging. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: reviewer_ids
parameters.description: Comma separated list of reviewers usernames omitting @ character. Set to empty string to unassign all reviewers.

parameters.name: source_branch
parameters.description: Merge request’s source branch. Ignored while updating existing merge request.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Create or delete merge request. Choices: "present" ← (default) "absent"

parameters.name: state_filter
parameters.description: Filter specifying state of merge requests while searching. Choices: "opened" ← (default) "closed" "locked" "merged"

parameters.name: target_branch
parameters.description: Merge request’s target branch.

parameters.name: title
parameters.description: A title for the merge request.

parameters.name: validate_certs
parameters.description: Whether or not to validate SSL certs when supplying a HTTPS endpoint. Choices: false true ← (default)

examples:
- name: Create Merge Request from branch1 to branch2
  community.general.gitlab_merge_request:
    api_url: https://gitlab.com
    api_token: secret_access_token
    project: "group1/project1"
    source_branch: branch1
    target_branch: branch2
    title: "Ansible demo MR"
    description: "Demo MR description"
    labels: "Ansible,Demo"
    state_filter: "opened"
    remove_source_branch: true
    state: present

- name: Delete Merge Request from branch1 to branch2
  community.general.gitlab_merge_request:
    api_url: https://gitlab.com
    api_token: secret_access_token
    project: "group1/project1"
    source_branch: branch1
    target_branch: branch2
    title: "Ansible demo MR"
    state_filter: "opened"
    state: absent

return_values.name: msg
return_values.description: Success or failure message. Returned: always Sample: "Success"
